body:
Each milestone on the Roadmap tab starts collapsed. Its heading row shows the title, state badge, `targetDate` and a feature count. Expanding it shows the body, its features and their tasks. Clicking the heading switches between collapsed and expanded.

- The heading's controls (**Edit**, **Delete**) stay on the collapsed row.
- A `milestone:<id>` link (D-122), and any link to a feature inside the milestone, expands that milestone before scrolling to it.
- Opening **Edit** expands the milestone.
- Which milestones are expanded is kept only until the page reloads.
- Update the README and the tests.

Left out: remembering which milestones were expanded across reloads, and an expand-all button.
title: roadmap: collapsible milestones
